description: Find tools, APIs, MCP servers, models and data providers for a job. Use it when a user needs a tool for a task, asks which ones exist or wants options narrowed by grade, price, auth or where data is processed. Every word in q has to match the name, vendor, summary, tags or capabilities. Returns graded listings first, each with its grade and score, how it authenticates, its price in one line and its hosted endpoint (grades from public evidence, see /benchmark/), then indexed listings (MCP servers from the official registry that clear the index's bar, APIs from APIs.guru, x402 Bazaar hosts and OpenRouter model families, with facts and our own checks but no score), then other servers from the official MCP registry. Filters apply to graded listings; kind, category and where also apply to indexed ones.

agentAlone.description: Only listings an agent can start using with no human (keyless, x402 or programmatic signup). Researched for the top listings; others don't match

agentReady.description: Only agent-ready listings (grade BB or better)

auth.description: How it authenticates: none, an API key, OAuth, a mix, or a personal access token

capability.description: A capability id from list_capabilities, e.g. web.search

category.description: A category slug from the directory, e.g. search, browser or database (list at /categories/)

cert.description: Certifications every result holds, comma-separated: SOC2, ISO27001, ISO27701, ISO42001, HIPAA, PCI, FedRAMP, CSA, GDPR

dpa.description: Only listings that offer a data processing agreement

includeRegistry.description: Also search the official MCP registry (default true)

kind.description: What sort of listing: an MCP server, an HTTP API, an SDK, a model, a model router, a model platform hosting other labs' models, open model weights you run yourself, an agent framework, an agent harness or a protocol

limit.description: How many graded listings to return (default 10)

minGrade.description: Lowest grade to include, AA best to F worst; BB and up is agent-ready

minRating.description: Average panel rating at least this (the panel's desk reviews)

noCard.description: Only listings that need no payment card before the first call

noTraining.description: Only listings whose vendor says it doesn't train on customers' data

pricing.description: How it charges: free, a free tier, per use, your own plan with the vendor, or paid only

q.description: What you need, in a few words: 'send email', 'web search', 'uk company data'

region.description: Where data is processed, any of US, EU, UK, CA, APAC, self-hosted, comma-separated

where.description: Where it runs: a hosted endpoint, a local server, both, a library or a spec

x402.description: Payable per call with USDC and no account

zeroRetention.description: Only listings that offer zero retention (on any plan, including enterprise)

name: search_tools
title: Search the directory
